title: Derived affine tilde is triangulated
statement: For any commutative ring A and derived-category universe choices, if F : D(A) → D_QCoh(Spec A) has a natural isomorphism between Q followed by F and inclusion and termwise tilde followed by Q, then F followed by inclusion admits an integer-shift structure for which it is triangulated.

proof.text: Use the shared SheafOfModules category from def-pc-derived-category. The tilde functor is additive there: its map-add equation is exactly Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.map_add. Let T be this functor, G be F followed by inclusion, and H be T.mapHomotopyCategory followed by DerivedCategory.Qh. Mathlib HomotopyCategory.instIsTriangulatedMapHomotopyCategory gives the triangulation of termwise additive T on homotopy categories; DerivedCategory.Qh is triangulated, so their composite H is triangulated (Functor.IsTriangulated.instComp).

Compose the assumed isomorphism with DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso on source and target and T.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors, using functor associators and whiskering. This gives quotient followed by Qh followed by G naturally isomorphic to quotient followed by H. The homotopy quotient has fully faithful precomposition; Functor.preimageIso therefore gives eh : Qh followed by G naturally isomorphic to H.

Register eh as Localization.Lifting for Qh and the homotopy quasi-isomorphisms. Apply Functor.commShiftOfLocalization to give G an integer-shift structure. Mathlib NatTrans.commShift_iso_hom_of_localization makes eh compatible with this structure. Finally Functor.isTriangulated_of_precomp_iso eh proves G triangulated, since Qh is triangulated and its arrow functor is essentially surjective. Return this shift structure and its triangulatedness. No exactness lemma or separate derived-tilde construction is needed, because the hypothesis already supplies the factorization.

theorem affineQCohDerivedEquivalence_core_triangulated (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (h : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⋙
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ≅
        @Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q)) :
    ∃ (_h : (F ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι).CommShift ℤ),
      (F ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι).IsTriangulated
